title: hedeoma bella
intro: Hedeoma bella, commonly known as American Pennyroyal, is a perennial herb native to North America, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedeoma bella include its ability to act as a carminative, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions like bloating, cramps, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Hedeoma bella include limonene, pinene, and other volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
